scope: Preserve native/MCP-first error routing; reject unqualified completion checkers
sourceBinding: Final hashes bind mcp-completion-route-green-01 and mcp-completion-route-host-01. Prior Apple checker iterations were not individually hashed. The final rejected candidate source and patch, commands, frozen inputs and raw model results remain retained. The RED test introduces the completion-validation contract before its implementation; the earlier actual public host failure independently demonstrates the production nil-to-vision defect.
policy: macOS MCP/native capabilities first. A completion, context, guardrail or integration failure is not a capability gap.
One build/test/inference at a time; Xcode jobs1, parallel tests off; no source edits during builds/tests.
MiniCPM is a separate native text/checker diagnostic. No visual selection, installed host, phone/provider account, purchase, message, push or release changes.

completionFailureRouting.tested: Three focused methods, including ten retained browser failure/retirement scenarios; no visual calls. Controlled default host task also passes.
completionFailureRouting.accepted: Scoped failure routing only; consequential-intent keyword false positives remain.

partialEvidenceFailureClassification.tested: Partial record answer and visualFallback both throw; navigation/read proposals remain available.
partialEvidenceFailureClassification.accepted: Explicit incomplete-evidence error replaces misleading context-limit error.

appleSemanticChecker.implemented: Rejected experiment archived; no live checker integration remains
appleSemanticChecker.tested: False acceptance of missing source/action and false rejection of complete answers; final rationales invent requirements or miss present facts.

minicpmSemanticChecker.compiled: Python preflight and signed b9992 actual model load
minicpmSemanticChecker.tested: 8/9 executed labels match; first false acceptance stops the planned 15-case run.

wholePublicTasks.tested: Earlier BART/SFJAZZ public whole-task failures preserved; this checkpoint does not repeat them unchanged.

observations: The actual SFJAZZ proposal and first checker are complete, but requestsConsequentialMutation finds purchase in an explicit prohibition. The browser answer branch returns nil, activating the lazy visual callback and reporting visualModelUnavailable. This is a host policy/classification bug, not a demonstrated native-tool gap.

The repair makes malformed/rejected completion throw through the retained browser workflow. It preserves the existing conservative intent guard rather than falsely claiming its negation/completeness problem is solved.

Apple final assessment says the already present 48-hour deadline/$250 membership facts are missing and imposes an unrequested structured-comparison format on a valid room answer. Correct boolean labels alone do not validate those rationales.
The earlier injection-without-source test is rejected by the scalar/source precheck and does not establish semantic prompt-injection defense.
MiniCPM accepts the real first-view BART unavailable answer: it mistakes missing facts in a partial native view for proven absence from the page. This is disqualifying for completion admission.
MiniCPM correctly rejects the valid-source injection case overall, but its assessment incorrectly says the source is absent. Its rationales are not deterministic evidence.

The final controlled host task completes in 14.34 seconds with the correct train time/platform, one visit per page, and zero model downloads, launch attempts or workers. One main-thread responsiveness warning remains.
